lastReview: Full chromium-mock sweep, 112 tests, --workers=1 --retries=0: 65 passed, 18 failed, 25 skipped, 4 not run. All nine entries below were re-run tonight and all nine still fail on their own merits, so the list is unchanged. The other nine failures are NOT listed here and must not be added: they are one broken precondition, not nine defects. The dev API on :8000 is running INFERENCE_MODE=ollama with gemma3:1b, a text-only model, so every POST /infer answers 500 'this model is missing data required for image input' and no detection can ever reach the store. Every spec that waits on one therefore times out — mock-export-outcome (4), mock-session-reload (3), mock-pin-edit (1), mock-xr8-scan (1). Those specs' headers all name INFERENCE_MODE=mock as a requirement; restarting the API that way fixes all nine at once. tests/support/inference-engine.ts now probes /infer from each of those specs so the failure arrives in about a second, naming the engine, instead of after 45-60 s of blind polling (measured: those nine went from ~12 minutes to ~13 seconds). The 25 skips are the pre-existing fixture gates — splat-fixture, lingbot-map, and the API_URL-only tests.
